senses.def: In computational complexity theory, the complexity class that is the set of decision problems that can be solved by a nondeterministic Turing machine which runs in time O(f(n)), where O is the big O notation, f is some function, and n is the size of the input (for which the problem is to be decided).
an agency in the Technology Administration that is a primary resource for government-funded scientific and technical and engineering and business related information
A form of histogram in which each bar represents (approximately) the same number of cases, in contrast to a typical histogram in which the bars (or categories) are all of the same width.
An archaeological culture at the start of the Central European Bronze Age, dated roughly to about 2300–1600 BC.
a bodhisattva in Mahayana and Vajrayana Buddhism
A female given name from Kwakʼwala
